requirements.text: The DUAP system shall collect probe vehicle data including fields corresponding to the SAE J2735 format.
The DUAP system shall collect traffic information from Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS).
The DUAP system shall collect weather information from multiple sources including Clarus and SAE J2354-compliant systems.
The DUAP system shall provide computational services to derive traffic metrics such as speed, congestion, queue length, and travel time from probe data.
The DUAP system shall provide computational services to infer incident occurrences, locations, and severity.
The DUAP system shall provide computational services to identify road surface conditions and pothole locations.
The DUAP system shall cache both raw and derived data for a minimum duration of one week.
The DUAP system shall provide a web-based presentation interface for browsing traffic, incident, traveler, asset, and weather information.
The DUAP system shall provide administrative services to configure, add, modify, and delete system services and manage user access.
The DUAP system shall log all data transactions across input, computational, persistent, output, and presentation services.
The DUAP system shall restrict access to authorized users and maintain records of user access.
The DUAP system shall be capable of handling large amounts of continuously streaming data.
The DUAP system shall provide data to users in near real-time to ensure operational value.
The system architecture shall be service-oriented to allow for the addition of new services and hardware scaling.
The system shall be capable of assessing data quality and utilizing data quality flags for incoming observations.
The user interface shall support standard web browsers including HTML 4.01, JavaScript, and XML 1.0 support.
The DUAP system shall conform to all IT standards established by the Michigan Department of Information Technology (MDIT).
